summary: Practise ICS command, Incident Action Plans and resource tracking in five days. Review the course outline and see if it fits your response role.
lede: An ICS incident response course teaches incident coordinators to establish command and turn changing information into clear operational plans. It is designed for incident commanders, planning and operations chiefs, and professionals responsible for field response or resource accountability. Practical exercises cover validating situation reports, setting objectives and tactical assignments, tracking resources, and preparing communications, safety, and handover records with ICS forms.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate field response, command functions, planning cycles or resource accountability during incidents.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of emergency response, incident operations or multi-team coordination is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your own incident procedures where available; local procedures may differ from the ICS examples used in class.
